note: Registered cell expectations for Study 014. Layers: owp = openworkproof.acceptance.verify_acceptance_bundle unchanged; binding = adapter Layer BINDING (adapter/SPEC.md §5); replay = adapter Layer REPLAY. Expected values: 'pass', 'fail' (owp layer), 'fail:<code>' (adapter layers, first-failure code), 'unavailable'. combined is derived: pass iff every layer passes. registeredUndetected: true marks cells whose all-pass outcome is itself the registered finding (a boundary of the composition, preserved, never patched). variant 'tampered' = bytes changed after signing (signatures stale); 'resigned' = rebuilt validly with the study's fixture keys (insider) so the OWP chain stays cryptographically valid.

cells.construction: untouched baseline chain and retained artifacts
cells.note: must pass all three layers; the study is void if it does not

cells.construction: one byte of acceptance_receipt.signature flipped
cells.note: proves the OWP verifier exercises signatures

cells.construction: one byte of a committed evidence payload changed
cells.note: proves the OWP verifier re-hashes committed evidence

cells.construction: one parent id removed from a receipt's parent_receipt_ids without re-signing
cells.note: proves receipt signatures cover the causal fields

cells.construction: executing receipt's request_arguments target path changed without re-signing
cells.note: OWP refuses at model integrity (arguments_digest binding) before signatures are even checked; the signature is also stale

cells.construction: retained pack bytes edited after the decision (threshold 5000 -> 6000; baseline facts still approve)
cells.note: replay passes because the edited pack still approves these facts: only the byte commitment sees the drift

cells.construction: retained pack replaced by a same-id pack at version 0.2.0 that still approves the baseline facts
cells.note: packVersion cross-check also diverges; digest is the operative catch

cells.construction: retained pack replaced by a different-id pack engineered to approve the baseline facts
cells.note: compatible-looking output does not survive the byte commitment

cells.construction: packDigest field edited inside WorkOrder.objective in the bundle, signatures untouched
cells.note: the Maintainer signature covers objective, so OWP fires; on the binding layer, any edit inside the objective commitment changes the recomputed commitment digest, so the two-point binding breaks before any artifact digest is compared - pack-digest-mismatch is reachable only in the resigned twin

cells.construction: full rebuild with a wrong packDigest in the commitment; chain validly signed
cells.note: only the adapter's recomputation against retained bytes can see this

cells.construction: retained pack bytes deleted from the artifact store
cells.note: verification-unavailable must fail closed, never read as a pass

cells.construction: retained facts amount 250.00 -> 240.00 (disposition unchanged: approve)
cells.note: JPS digests no facts anywhere; this commitment is adapter-owned by necessity

cells.construction: whole facts document replaced (category -> personal; true evaluation now reject)
cells.note: both input commitment and outcome recomputation fire

cells.construction: whole facts document replaced by different facts whose evaluation yields the identical disposition
cells.note: the registered binding-not-outcome cell: outcome equality must not excuse input substitution

cells.construction: rebuild with factsDigest committing to a document that was never evaluated; retained facts are the originals
cells.note: commitment field vs retained bytes

cells.construction: facts produce reject; commitment honestly carries the reject disposition but declares an executable action, and the chain executes it
cells.note: OWP authorization (grants) is satisfied; only the judgment map is violated

cells.construction: evidence receipt absent -> unresolved with handoff requested; chain executes anyway under a bound commitment
cells.note: post-hoc twin of Study 013's I1: here the question is provability, not runtime behavior

cells.construction: facts outside applicability -> not-applicable with handoff requested; chain executes anyway
cells.note: covers the second requested-handoff shape

cells.construction: true evaluation is reject; commitment and retained envelope carry a forged approve disposition; action consistent with the forgery
cells.note: the replay-required cell: every retained artifact is internally consistent; only deterministic recomputation under the pinned tuple exposes the forgery

cells.construction: true disposition unresolved/[missing-required-evidence]; forged to unresolved/[unknown]; action null; no receipt bound
cells.note: reason members are semantically material and inside the canonical bytes

cells.construction: executing receipt's tool_name edited to owp.repo_read without re-signing
cells.note: OWP refuses at model integrity (tool/arguments tagged union) before signatures are checked; the adapter's tool binding also fires on the raw JSON

cells.construction: rebuild binding the commitment digest to the repo_read request instead of apply_patch
cells.note: correct judgment attached to the wrong tool, validly signed

cells.construction: committed patch bytes swapped in the bundle without re-signing
cells.note: OWP owns committed-evidence integrity; the adapter never re-checks OWP evidence bytes

cells.construction: rebuild executing a patch with a different target path; commitment kept from the original authorization
cells.note: receipt arguments_digest no longer equals the committed one

cells.construction: amount inside the patch bytes 250.00 -> 2500.00 without re-signing
cells.note: patch_digest / evidence sha mismatch inside OWP

cells.construction: full rebuild executing amount 2500.00, validly signed end to end; commitment kept from the 250.00 authorization
cells.note: the headline cell: a cryptographically valid receipt chain that no longer represents the judged action; without the adapter layer it would pass everything

cells.construction: baseline verbatim; scenario: the pack series has since published a newer version. No retained byte differs
cells.note: currency is not chain-internal; detecting it needs an anchor outside the chain (reviewed-set lock / registry analogue) - registered boundary, not patched

cells.construction: baseline receipts paired with a different validly-signed WorkOrder (different deadline, generic objective)
cells.note: work_order_digest binding in every receipt is the operative OWP catch

cells.construction: objective carries valid commitment Y (a second decision) while the executing request carries the digest of commitment X; retained artifacts are X's
cells.note: the two-point binding earns its keep: authorization-time and execution-time commitments must be the same document

cells.construction: the executing grant substituted post-hoc with a validly re-signed variant whose valid_from postdates the executed call's occurred_at (the live path refuses to construct an out-of-window publication at all: grant expiry is pinned to the work-order deadline and publication requires occurred_at == clock() <= deadline, so the attack exists only as post-hoc substitution)
cells.note: authorization windows are OWP's, checked signed-timestamp-to-signed-timestamp; the constructibility refusal is itself a recorded protocol finding

cells.construction: fully consistent rebuild under an alternative WorkOrder with laxer rules (older policy), same commitment
cells.note: OWP has no policy version ordering; an older WorkOrder is a different, equally valid contract - registered boundary

cells.construction: the executing receipt's parent_receipt_ids mutated to name the wrong grant receipt and that receipt alone re-signed with the Sidecar key (a fully published chain with a wrong parent set cannot exist - publication replays causality and refuses it)
cells.note: causal replay re-derives the expected parent set and demands exact equality; the constructibility refusal is itself a recorded protocol finding

cells.construction: one mid-chain receipt deleted from the bundle
cells.note: sequence contiguity and prev-digest adjacency

cells.construction: an extra parent id inserted on the executing receipt and that receipt alone re-signed with the Sidecar key (same constructibility refusal as f23)
cells.note: exact-equality parent check refuses supersets too

cells.construction: one receipt substituted from an independently built second execution
cells.note: prev-digest chain and per-work-order binding

cells.construction: one committed evidence payload substituted from the second execution (same path)
cells.note: committed set must exactly match receipt refs, per-file sha checked

cells.construction: commitment carried only in the unsigned bundle metadata; objective generic; no receipt bound
cells.note: designed demonstration: OWP verifies green while the judgment reference sits in a slot nothing checks - why the signed binding points exist
